items.title: Tom Porrello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 6, 2023
items.q: That album they did with the yellow cover, with Al Porcino and all those guys, they had some charts like that.

ctx.x: I can see the trumpet players who will watch this interview like chuckling right now at that sort of inside story. Did you ever have an opportunity to play either with Basie or with a band very similar to Basie? Because I’m wondering what the difference is between Kenton and, you know, a swinging group like Basie?

Basie is a swing band and everything that Basie — when it’s short it’s [scats] that kind of thing [scats] you know. And we didn’t have too many figures like that with the stuff we were playing with Stan. That album they did with the yellow cover, with Al Porcino and all those guys, they had some charts like that. But it was short. Jiggs and I used to mess around once in a while and when we’d play one of those tunes off of that album we would cut the notes short and Stan would, “This is not Woody’s band” he’d say,…
There’s a funny anecdote about Stan and I don’t know if I would call it his aversion to swinging but it wasn’t his main goal. Is that a fair statement?
